findings: The company's Brunei-based subsidiary, Polygel Organometallic (B) Sdn Bhd, is operated as a joint venture with the Strategic Development Capital Fund under the Ministry of Finance and Economy of Brunei Darussalam.

The company secured a USD 10 million investment from the Muscat Precious Metals Refining (MPMR) Group to support its ASEAN and Oceania regional expansion, asset digitization, and technology-led processing workflows.
We verified that the company possesses a structured joint venture with a sovereign development fund and has successfully raised institutional growth capital.
